newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues envelopes to mark Hong Kong takeover.
newsitem.headline: China issues envelopes to mark Hong Kong takeover.

text.p: China planned to issue five sets of souvenir envelopes to mark the return of Hong Kong to Chinese rule on July 1 1997, the Xinhua Daily Telegraph said on Monday.
The envelopes would be issued in both Beijing and Hong Kong, the newspaper said. They would be sold from August 29 through July 1, 1997.
The envelopes would have both Chinese and Hong Kong stamps.
